Description: Extend DEPLOYMENT.md: make-admin command storage permissions writable storage symlink and PHP upload limits for product images.
Acceptance Criteria: Operators can deploy admin features without tribal knowledge.

Title: Audit log for catalog changes (products and producers)
Description: Log who changed what on product and producer writes (user id timestamp action snapshot) for support and traceability common in marketplace ops.
Acceptance Criteria: Support can answer what changed and when without raw DB forensics.

Title: Draft or unpublished products optional workflow
Description: Add is_published or status draft so admins can prepare listings before shop visibility; shop queries exclude drafts.
Acceptance Criteria: Draft products never appear in shop or box composition; publish toggles visibility.

Title: UX redesign baseline competitor research and route matrix
Description: Benchmark farm-box and organic D2C patterns (e.g. Oddbox Abel Cole Riverford CrowdFarming-style storytelling and account hubs). Define design principles: mobile-first hierarchy spacing typography CTAs. Maintain a route-to-ticket matrix covering all customer-facing named routes through ERD-169 to ERD-181. Exclude ops-only routes (public.cron.run API webhooks) from visual redesign scope unless noted in ERD-183.
Acceptance Criteria: One-pager or linked doc with inspiration screenshots and principles; matrix lists route name and owning ticket; product agrees P0 page order.

Title: Marketing home landing flow and visual design
Description: Rethink GET / (public.home): hero value prop trust signals how-it-works social proof and primary CTA path to register or subscription create. Compare landing clarity with leading veg-box brands; optimize scanability and speed to signup.
Acceptance Criteria: Wireframe or implemented design approved; single clear primary CTA; mobile hero and above-the-fold messaging tested; no broken links to auth or app.

Title: About page story and layout
Description: Rethink GET /about (public.about): narrative arc team or farm story sourcing values FAQ entry. Align tone with regional organic positioning; improve imagery and section rhythm vs generic brochure pages.
Acceptance Criteria: Page tells a coherent story with scannable sections; CTA to subscribe or contact; responsive imagery and text balance.

Title: Producers listing discovery and cards
Description: Rethink GET /producers (public.producers): card grid filters or regions optional search producer detail depth. Take cues from marketplace farmer directories; strengthen provenance and link-out to shop or signup where relevant.
Acceptance Criteria: Producers are easy to browse on mobile; empty state if no producers; consistent card component with photo name region.

Title: Contact form flow and confirmation
Description: Rethink GET /contact and POST /contact (public.contact public.contact.store): field grouping privacy note success confirmation inline errors loading state. Compare with support forms on subscription services; reduce friction while keeping honeypot and throttle awareness in copy if needed.
Acceptance Criteria: Form has clear labels and accessible errors; success state confirms next steps; mobile keyboard-friendly; matches marketing visual system.

Title: Auth screens unified layout and flows
Description: Rethink all Breeze auth routes under /auth: register login forgot-password reset-password verify-email confirm-password password update logout. Align with patterns from modern SaaS and grocery accounts: minimal distraction clear next step password strength hints resend verification. Single auth layout component with consistent logo and footer links.
Acceptance Criteria: All auth screens share consistent layout; error and flash messaging readable; mobile-first forms; documented redirect targets after login and verification.

Title: App shell navigation and dashboard hub
Description: Rethink authenticated chrome and GET /app/dashboard (app.dashboard): information architecture for primary nav vs account menu next delivery box deadline payment nudges and quick actions. Inspired by subscription account homepages (meal kits veg boxes). Resolve where subscription delivery box shop and payments sit in hierarchy.
Acceptance Criteria: Dashboard answers what is next this week in under 5 seconds; nav labels match user mental model; admin link remains visible only to admins; empty states for new subscribers.

Title: Subscription management UX end to end
Description: Rethink subscription routes: app.subscriptions.show create store edit update pause resume cancel. Flow for new subscriber vs active: plan selection preferences allergies pause windows cancel retention. Use clear step indicators and confirmation patterns similar to major subscription retailers.
Acceptance Criteria: Each action has confirmation where destructive; pause resume cancel copy is unambiguous; create path aligns with payment setup ticket ERD-179; validation errors surfaced per field.

Title: Deliveries weekly management and preferences UX
Description: Rethink app.deliveries.index preferences edit update show override update skip postpone gift gift store. Timeline or calendar mental model for next weeks; distinguish permanent preferences vs one-off overrides; gift and skip flows with plain-language outcomes. Reference delivery management UX from box schemes and grocery slots.
Acceptance Criteria: User can understand default vs this week only changes; skip postpone gift show expected billing or delivery impact; mobile-friendly list and detail; accessible forms.

Title: Weekly box composition UX
Description: Rethink app.boxes.current show items add updateQuantity remove. Editing gated states and deadlines communicated visually (countdown badges read-only mode). Budget and included value surfaced like market basket UIs; extras clearly labeled.
Acceptance Criteria: Locked vs editable states obvious; quantity controls work on touch; totals update predictably; empty box state handled; aligns with shop sticky summary patterns.

Title: Shop catalog and product detail UX
Description: Rethink app.shop.index and app.shop.show: filters chips search optional sort product storytelling add-to-box affordance. Borrow from farm shop and specialty grocery PDPs: origin producer taste notes imagery grid density.
Acceptance Criteria: Catalog scannable on mobile; filters discoverable; PDP supports add extra with clear price and dietary info; loading states for grid.

Title: Payment setup history and update UX
Description: Rethink app.payments.history setup setup.complete update: trust framing SumUp widget placement success and failure recovery receipt-like history table. Compare payment method management on subscription services; explicit security reassurance without jargon.
Acceptance Criteria: User always knows if mandate is active; history readable on small screens; update flow replaces method with confirmation; widget errors map to human copy; complements ERD-119 a11y for forms.

Title: Account profile and access UX
Description: Rethink account.profile edit update destroy and account.users.show: settings grouping danger zone delete account confirm password alignment with auth.confirm. Decide if users.show remains a debug probe or is removed from customer IA; if kept hide from main nav.
Acceptance Criteria: Profile settings match app visual system; destructive actions require explicit confirm; email change implications documented in UI if applicable.

Title: Admin back-office UX for catalog operations
Description: Rethink app.admin.dashboard and resource routes for producers and products (no show routes): list tables search bulk actions upload previews validation feedback. Efficiency-first patterns from small ecommerce admin (Shopify-lite clarity) without full redesign of backend logic.
Acceptance Criteria: Common tasks (add product upload image assign producer) need minimal clicks; tables responsive or scroll-safe; destructive actions confirmed; consistent with app theme optional distinct admin accent.

Title: Cross-cutting UI kit and states
Description: Unify buttons cards forms modals toasts skeletons empty states and status badges across marketing auth and app layouts. WCAG AA contrast targets for text and focus rings. Document component usage for engineers. Builds on ERD-119 accessibility backlog where overlapping.
Acceptance Criteria: Shared tokens or Tailwind patterns documented; key journeys have empty loading error examples; focus order verified on dashboard subscription delivery box shop checkout.

Title: Ops and system routes UX scope note
Description: Clarify scope for GET /health (public.health) GET /cron/run (public.cron.run) and POST /api/sumup/webhook: no full customer UX; optional minimal JSON or monitoring copy only. Prevents duplicate design tickets for non-human flows.
Acceptance Criteria: Written note in UX doc or ticket ERD-168 appendix; team agrees no mockups required unless branding on error responses.
